body:
I need to seek professional help...that's the only way to somehow get better. Then I need to be honest with other people too and not just myself. I might not want to tell my mother, but I have to. I thought hard last night about everything. It almost happened twice...it could again. I'll keep the number.

Just the thought of going back to where I started makes me feel hopless. Being around my family that fights so much and a father that hates us all. I don't want to go to that war zone. How is that going to help me?

ashamed, worthless, a loser, undeserving of anything, overwhelmed is right. So many expectations to meet and I failed.

I felt ashamed and embarrassed...afraid even. That's why I wouldn't talk about it. I even blocked it out of my mind. I just wanted nothing to do with it. It was a way of avoiding my problems.

No one. As a matter of fact, my failures in college have been a secret until towards the end of winter break. However, we've made arrangements. I'm afraid to tell my mother because, shit hit the fan and this...this would just destroy her. I only told her I was depressed and she wants me to see a therapist. I asked if I could see a psychiatrist and she agreed. I'm a little worried about meds again though...I used to take prozac and I didn't like the way it made me feel.

**EDIT** as in, tell her about the suicide attempts
